[Interlude – Spoken Word] Mmm~ Ooh~ (Sorry… your call went unanswered.)
[Verse 2] I just wanted to be seen, not your ghost on repeat. Didn’t need the crown, just wanted my seat. You moved on fast, I stayed still — Saw you walk the aisle, I learned how to heal. You became somebody’s groom, And I walked out of that room, Smiling soft, though I was breaking in two.
[Pre-Chorus] You said “You’re my only one,” But I already knew it was done. So I wish you well, wish you peace — Guess freedom’s what I need.
[Chorus] You were my only one, wish you could feel the same. You had your choices, I only had your name. (Only you~) You let my tears fall down, You let my heart fade out. (Baby~) Now I’m taking care of me, And maybe one day you’ll see — You don’t need a million hearts to feel complete.
[Bridge – Floaty High Notes] Under the moonlight, stars flicker slow, Our future never had a rainbow. If tomorrow glows, I hope it shines through, If my goodbye still echoes — that’s proof I loved you. (Oooh~)
[Chorus – Extended - Key Change] I wish I was your only one, but I won’t beg for love. You made everyone feel special, While I was never enough. (Only you!) I blamed myself, just to keep you safe, But you left me anyway. Now I’m good, I don’t need to pray — Just hope your new love breaks you the same. (Mmm~) No hate, just closure in disguise, So drive safe, boy — see you in another life.
[Outro – Spoken Word - Dreamy Fade] Old love… not everyone gon’ love you like me. But that’s okay, I finally set me free. That’s it — I don’t wanna talk. (Haha…)
